evidence.explanation: The native monster attack catalog has no AT_MAGC/AD_FIRE slot. castmu direct AD_FIRE feedback is unreachable through native attack dispatch; this does not apply to clerical FIRE_PILLAR, breath or explosions.
evidence.proof: probe.test.mjs compiles pinned C monsters.h with MAIL_STRUCTURES and no CHARON, compares all 48 native magic slots with JS, preserves Angel/Yeenoghu AD_MAGM and Asmodeus AD_COLD controls, checks native getmattk variants and pins absence of substitutions introducing AT_MAGC or AD_FIRE. Recheck on catalog, substitution or dispatch changes.
